notes: The two supplied possessives, their nests (t008) and their young (t026), are added: no suffix or other possessive morpheme stands in the Hebrew (rules 18, 44, 30); each note names the competing reading that folds them into the verb.
Both denominative/light-verb renderings are headed on their complements, nests and young (rule 44).
The ASV reorders the clause heavily, so several units — notably בִּ (t010) and did ... bring forth (t017, t024–t025, t027) — are discontinuous under rule 25.
